# Doc Holiday Library

> Concept-level field guides to open-source codebases, written by Doc Holiday
> (https://doc.holiday) by exploring each project's source directly. Each guide explains
> why a subsystem exists, its central abstractions, and how it relates to its neighbors —
> the mental models the official docs usually leave out. Every guide page is also served
> as plain Markdown (append `/index.md` to any page URL), and each guide has its own
> llms.txt index linked below.

## Guides

- [DSPy Field Guide](https://doc.holiday/library/dspy/the-big-picture/): the DSPy codebase — Signature, Module, Adapter, and the LM layer, plus caching, compilation, the proposer, and streaming. Index: https://doc.holiday/library/dspy/llms.txt
- [Strix Field Guide](https://doc.holiday/library/strix/the-big-picture/): the Strix codebase — an autonomous pentest app built on the OpenAI Agents SDK, from the agent graph to the Docker sandbox and the finding-to-report pipeline. Index: https://doc.holiday/library/strix/llms.txt
- [browser-use Field Guide](https://doc.holiday/library/browser-use/the-big-picture/): the browser-use codebase — an AI browser-automation agent, from the event bus and watchdogs to the CDP execution layer, the action registry, and how the agent sees the page. Index: https://doc.holiday/library/browser-use/llms.txt
- [RAGFlow Field Guide](https://doc.holiday/library/ragflow/the-big-picture/): the RAGFlow codebase — a deep-document RAG engine, from the ingestion pipeline and chunking templates to the embedding layer, GraphRAG, and the canvas orchestrator. Index: https://doc.holiday/library/ragflow/llms.txt
- [Dify Field Guide](https://doc.holiday/library/dify/the-big-picture/): the Dify codebase — an LLM app platform and its Graphon workflow engine, from the graph execution model and variable system to pause/resume, the model runtime, and the plugin system. Index: https://doc.holiday/library/dify/llms.txt
- [CrewAI Field Guide](https://doc.holiday/library/crewai/the-big-picture/): the CrewAI codebase — a multi-agent orchestration framework, from the kickoff and agent-executor loop to the hierarchical process, the flow scheduler, and where state lives. Index: https://doc.holiday/library/crewai/llms.txt
- [n8n Field Guide](https://doc.holiday/library/n8n/the-big-picture/): the n8n codebase — a workflow-automation engine, from how the engine decides what runs next and why the canvas is not the execution to partial executions, items and pairedItem, and triggers. Index: https://doc.holiday/library/n8n/llms.txt
- [Letta Field Guide](https://doc.holiday/library/letta/the-big-picture/): the Letta v2 codebase — a stateful agent harness, from the turn lifecycle and per-conversation queues to memory blocks, the git-tracked memory filesystem, dreaming, and client-side tools. Index: https://doc.holiday/library/letta/llms.txt
- [LangGraph Field Guide](https://doc.holiday/library/langgraph/the-big-picture/): the LangGraph codebase — a durable agent runtime, from the superstep engine and the version-trigger mechanism to how state compiles to channels, control flow, and what checkpoints really store. Index: https://doc.holiday/library/langgraph/llms.txt

## About Doc Holiday

- Doc Holiday (https://doc.holiday) is the AI-native software platform that automatically transforms code commits and product specs into crystal-clear documentation and release notes that stay up-to-date while you stay out late. These field guides are generated and maintained the same way.
